senses.gloss:
(ऋ) शोणृ r. 1st cl. (शोणति)
1 To be red.
2 To move or approach.

mfn. (-णः-णा or णी-णं)
1 Crimson, of a crimson colour.
2 Red in the face, from passion, &c.
m. (-णः)
1 Crimson, the colour of the red lotus.
2 A horse of a reddish or bright chesnut colour.
3 The Śoṇa river, which rises in the table land of Amarakaṇṭaka, and running first northerly and then easterly for 500 miles, falls into the Ganges above Patna.
4 A flower, (Bignonia Indica.)
5 Fire or its deity.
6 An ocean.
7 A red sort of sugar-cane.
n. (-णं)
1 Red-lead.
2 Blood.
E.
शोण to be red, aff. अच्, fem. aff. ठाप् or ङीप्.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Bignonia Indica.)
E.
शोण red, अक to go or be, aff. अच्.

n. (-त्नं)
A ruby.
E.
शोण deep red, and रत्न a gem.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Red, crimson, purple.
n. (-तं)
1 Blood.
2 Saffron.
E.
शोण redness, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Who or what drinks blood.
E.
शोणित, and पा to drink, क aff.

n. (-रं)
The city of Bānāsur.
E.
शोणित red, and पुर city.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Stained or sprinkled with blood.
E.
शोणित, and उक्षित moistened.

n. (-लं)
A ruby.
E.
शोणित red, and उपल a stone.

m. (-मा)
Redness.
E.
शोण, and इमनिच् aff.
